subject: MSA & Order Form — clarifying scope, billing, and exhibits
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Nora Chen <nora.chen@nimbus.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA & Order Form — clarifying scope, billing, and exhibits

Hi Nora —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our discussion, attaching Redwood's current MSA (v3.2) and our standard Order Form template so your team can start an initial pass. To get the contract loop moving, can you confirm the following items this week?

- Full legal entity name for contracting and the billing entity (exact format for PO/invoice).
- Does Nimbus require invoices in GBP/EUR or USD? Any PO number or supplier onboarding portal requirements?
- Primary procurement contact (name, email, phone) for invoicing and tax forms.
- Data residency: will production workload for this project be hosted in AWS eu-west-1 only, or do you have additional region constraints?
- Any mandatory exhibits — e.g., IP Exhibit, Data Processing Addendum, security addendum — that we should prepare?
- SLA/uptime targets beyond our standard Dedicated offering (we can surface enterprise SLA language if needed).

For scope sizing: kindly share an estimate of monthly active requests and expected average sequence length (or token-equivalent) so we can complete the Order Form fields (usage tiers drive capacity & pricing).

To speed review, you can attach redlines as a tracked-changes Word doc or use the DocuSign draft link in my signature. Ben from our contracts team will be the primary contract reviewer once we have your redline.

Attachments: redwood_msa_v3.2.docx (Redwood standard MSA), redwood_orderform_template.xlsx

Next steps I propose: if I don't hear back by Thu EOD PT, I'll set up a 30-min legal sync (Vanessa, Priyom, Ben + Nora).

Thanks — looking forward to moving this along.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
DocuSign draft: https://www.docusign.com/agreements/drafts/5a2b3c

From: Nora Chen <nora.chen@nimbus.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbus.com
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 10:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — clarifying scope, billing, and exhibits

Vanessa —

Thanks for the materials and the clear checklist. Quick answers and follow-ups from our side:

- Legal entity: Nimbus Systems Ltd (registered as "Nimbus Systems Limited" in our contracts); billing: Nimbus Systems Ltd (VAT ID: GB987654321).
- Invoice currency: GBP preferred; we can process USD if necessary. We require a PO for payments > £10,000 and use Coupa for supplier onboarding (portal: vendors@nimbus.com).
- Procurement contact: Tom Aldridge, tom.aldridge@nimbus.com, +44 20 7000 1111.
- Data residency: production will be constrained to eu-west-1; we need a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and confirmation of subprocessor list.
- Exhibits: we will need an IP carve-out for customer-provided models and a DPA referencing UK/EU transfer clauses.

Attached is our initial tracked-change redline (nimbus_msa_redline.docx). High-level items we intend to change: limitation of liability caps, indemnity reciprocity, and clarification on export controls.

We also need a short SOW that lists the environments, expected throughput, and a go-live target (we are looking at mid-Jan 2026). Can Redwood propose a draft Order Form with usage bands based on token forecasts?

Happy to jump on a review call — Thu 14:00 UK / 06:00 PT works for me.

Best,
Nora Chen
General Counsel
Nimbus Systems Ltd

Subject: Re: MSA & Order Form — clarifying scope, billing, and exhibits

Hi Nora, Vanessa —

Looping back with the usage and billing details to fill the Order Form:

- Expected monthly usage (estimate): 45M tokens (mix of short assistants + long form generation), peak sustained QPS ~ 18 req/s.
- Expected average sequence length: ~350 tokens per request.
- Preferred billing entity (as agreed with finance): Nimbus Systems Ltd (GBP invoicing).
- PO/Procurement portal: we can accept a PO; please have Tom send POs to ar-uk@nimbus.com and copy procurement@nimbus.com.
- Go-live target: mid-Jan 2026; suggested pilot window: 6 weeks starting 2025-12-15.

Attached: sample_orderform_completed.xlsx (draft numbers populated), sample_sow_outline.pdf

Thanks — Ben will re-review contractual language once we have Nimbus's redline. Vanessa, I'll book the legal sync for Thu 14:00 UK.

— Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive, EMEA
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com

Nora —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the redline. Per Priyom's numbers we have what we need to draft an Order Form and populate capacity bands. Ben will take primary ownership on contract comments; Ben — please review Nimbus's redline and prepare a short comment log ahead of the call.

I've scheduled a 30-min legal sync for Thu 14:00 UK / Thu 06:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. Agenda: 1) walk Nimbus redline (15 min), 2) confirm DPA and subprocessor list requirement (5 min), 3) next steps & timeline (10 min).

If Nimbus prefers, you can upload the tracked-change Word doc to the DocuSign draft or share via a secure link so our contracts team can attach it to the DocuSign envelope. Otherwise we'll work from the attached redline you sent.

Next deliverables from Redwood: updated Order Form draft, draft DPA (if requested), and a short contracts comment log — target delivery: Tue 11 Nov 2025.

Thanks again — see you on Thu.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
